project_notes:
Preliminary VVF layout candidate. Geometry based on an aerial image; verify as-built roof edges, all openings/EFC, access and roof load. Eight modules moved from zone 5 row 0 to zone 7 row 2. Strings 13-20 repartitioned provisionally. All actual cable paths and lengths, electrical ratings, BESS fire risk and protective devices require detailed engineering. Do not use as an installation drawing.
Confirmed architecture: three Deye SUN-125K-SG02HP3-EU-GM10 hybrid inverters; INV3 initially PV-only, battery port reserved. The prior vendor drawing with one string inverter is superseded. Existing 31 strings and 28 occupied MPPT assignments (out of 30 available) retained. Cable calculator length set to zero because no routed lengths are measured; see separate electrical verification PDF and CSV for assumed geometry scenarios. Module model and final 1303 mm width require confirmation.
Proposed roof tray network saved in cable_paths for plan visualization. A separate electrical_route_plan_3d stores each string terminal (A and B), 11/8 m roof heights, two-pole lengths, estimated drop and sections. The legacy program does NOT automatically include altitude or both conductors; do not interpret automatic diagram distances as verified 3-D cable lengths. Recompute after module moves or actual route changes.

electrical_route_plan_3d.status: SCHEMATIC - roof corridors/penetrations must be surveyed
electrical_route_plan_3d.coordinate_system: roof image pixels calibrated by px_per_mm
electrical_route_plan_3d.polarity_note: A = first string module, B = last. Confirm actual + and - at commissioning.
